findings.Root_Cause: No AI provider integration; roles are rule tables
findings.Operational_Impact: The 'Black Team / Red Advocate / Adjudicator' labels describe simulations; no case is reasoned about
findings.Required_Code_Change: Introduce a provider adapter layer (cdf_gco_crms/agents/providers) with a typed invocation record (17.1 fields), retries, timeouts and a mock provider clearly labelled MOCK_PROVIDER
findings.Acceptance_Test: MODE B: adapter unit tests incl. timeout/invalid-JSON/rate-limit; MODE C: one live Black Team inference on an unseen case with a recorded Invocation_ID

findings.Root_Cause: run_challenge runs all roles in one process on shared objects
findings.Required_Code_Change: Role runner that builds a separate context per role (05.2–05.4 information boundaries), separate invocation per role, no shared mutable objects; keep the deterministic engine as a pre-check
findings.Acceptance_Test: context_isolation_audit: distinct Execution_ID/Context_ID per role, planted labels inaccessible, boundary tests for each role

findings.Root_Cause: Issuing commands (round1/append/build-excel/build-word) never call the challenge; blockers do not stop a build
findings.Operational_Impact: Pre-issue review is optional and unenforced
findings.Required_Code_Change: Add an `issue` command (or a --require-review flag enforced by build-excel/build-word) that refuses to build while the latest ChallengeRecord for that state hash has blockers or is absent
findings.Acceptance_Test: runtime_callgraph: build after BLOCKED review returns rc 3; test_e2e asserts the gate

findings.Root_Cause: Advocacy.revised_comment, revised_quote, route_to have no consumer
findings.Operational_Impact: A valid objection cannot change the observation; AI-031/AI-032 fail
findings.Required_Code_Change: apply_dispositions(state, record, decisions): apply UPHELD_WITH_REVISION/NARROWED/ROUTED to the ReviewState only under a verified human decision, with history
findings.Acceptance_Test: test: revised comment appears in the rebuilt workbook and Word comment after a signed decision; never without one

findings.Root_Cause: Rule table accuracy 0.656 < 0.80 on unseen cases; taxonomy disagreement (breach×REVISE → NARROWED)
findings.Operational_Impact: Wrong dispositions on ~1/3 of unseen cases
findings.Required_Code_Change: Document the disposition table in 19A.6 or align it; add the blind evaluation harness (this audit's cases) to CI with a frozen key

findings.Root_Cause: Mandate-overlap thresholds (0.34/0.5) miss technical-specialisation and misrouting cases; 4 of 20 objection categories have no rule
findings.Operational_Impact: Detection 0.765 on covered categories; 0 on uncovered
findings.Required_Code_Change: Either extend rules (existing-provision scan, fabricated-citation check, proposed-structure-as-approved, working-method overreach) or hand these to a live agent (R-01/R-02)
findings.Acceptance_Test: Valid_Objection_Detection_Rate ≥ 0.80 and uncovered categories ≥ 0.5 on the sealed set

findings.Operational_Impact: No independent final read exists; R1–R7 never measured
findings.Required_Code_Change: Implement the Article 20 reader as an isolated run with a clean context (finalised draft + titles + evidence only) and the G-UX-17/R7 gate
findings.Acceptance_Test: 20.4 thresholds computed on a synthetic review; context contains no 19A record

findings.Root_Cause: No validity window, expiry or revocation for HumanDecision; trust store is a caller dict
findings.Operational_Impact: A stale but validly signed decision is accepted; no institutional key management
findings.Required_Code_Change: Add issued_at/valid_until and a revocation list to the trust store; load the trust store from an institution-managed location with its own signature
findings.Acceptance_Test: human_authority_audit attempt 9 rejected; trust-store provenance recorded

findings.Root_Cause: Duplicate control is exact canonical text only
findings.Required_Code_Change: Normalise punctuation/whitespace/diacritics in canon(); add a token-overlap or embedding similarity threshold for semantic duplicates

findings.Operational_Impact: Every reference is NOT_ESTABLISHED; AI-019 fails
findings.Required_Code_Change: Applicability evaluation step (rule or agent) with its own evidence record and the VERIFIED/SUPPORTED_BUT_NOT_CONCLUSIVE/UNVERIFIED/CONTRADICTED/NOT_APPLICABLE scale of 13.5
findings.Acceptance_Test: cases with applicable vs inapplicable provisions classified correctly

findings.Root_Cause: The 'title' field of the round-1 JSON is dropped
findings.Operational_Impact: Proposed titles must be re-entered at finalize-titles
findings.Acceptance_Test: 07_finalize-titles trace applies the proposal without re-entry

findings.Root_Cause: pdftotext subprocess inside the assurance package
findings.Operational_Impact: Minor: fixed binary, read-only; still an execution channel in a package that will host agents
findings.Required_Code_Change: Move PDF extraction to ingestion/ with an allow-list and timeout; keep assurance/ free of subprocess
